info.title: MAS Lab API
info.description: REST interface for mas-lab — scope-based HTTP API with persisted runs

get.description: List FastAPI jobs plus in-process controller workers.

delete.description: Remove jobs. With origin, UI-owned runs are dropped even if still running.

get.description: Get full details of a specific job (including stdout/stderr).

delete.description: Cancel a running job and drop it from the in-memory list.

get.description: Unified lab + runtime registry catalog.
Agent and infra defaults (design pattern, model) for UI and playground.
Paths scanned, libraries resolved, and runtime entry points (debug).
List available MAS libraries.
List registered lab runtime plugins (mas, langgraph, autogen, …).

List available tools for a specific library.

The *namespaces* query parameter is a comma-separated list of scopes.
``"global"`` returns tools under the library root ``tools/`` folder
(prefixed with ``global/``).  Any other value is treated as an app
name and returns tools under ``apps/{name}/tools/``.

List available skills for a specific library.

``namespaces`` is a comma-separated list of scopes: ``global`` for
library-root skills (prefixed ``global/``), or an app name for
app-scoped skills (no prefix).  Defaults to ``global``.
Read a file under the library root (MAS YAML, agent YAML, overlays).
List available topology manifests in a library.
Return infra, flavour, and workspace config files for the control panel.
List available pipeline definitions with metadata.

post.description: Create a new pipeline definition in the library's pipelines/ directory.

get.description: List available MAS scenario files (mas.yaml in apps/<name>/).

post.description:
Validate a kind: Overlay overlay manifest.

Uses the same schema (overlay.schema.yaml) regardless of whether the overlay
is intended for mas-ctl run-mas or mas-lab benchmark run — the schema does
not differentiate between the two usage contexts.

get.description: List available overlay files with name and description (includes nested lab modules).

post.description:
Create a new overlay definition.

Storage location is determined by ``metadata.namespace`` in the YAML content:
``global`` → ``{lib}/overlays/``, otherwise → ``{lib}/apps/{ns}/overlays/``.

get.description: Return the content of a specific overlay definition.

put.description: Update an existing overlay definition. Supports rename and namespace change.

post.description: Validate an agent or MAS manifest in-process. Resolves refs relative to the library dir.
Run an agent with a single query in-process. Returns a job_id for polling.
Run an agent with multiple sequential queries. Returns a job_id for polling.
Run a MAS with a single query. Returns a job_id for polling.

get.description: List available dataset YAML files under datasets/.

post.description: Create a new dataset file in the library's datasets/ directory.

get.description: Return the content of a specific dataset.

put.description: Update an existing dataset. Supports rename via req.name.

post.description: Run a benchmark experiment. Returns a job_id for polling.
Regenerate statistics/plots for an existing benchmark run.
Export a benchmark run to a portable .tar.gz archive.

get.description: Export and download a benchmark run as a .tar.gz file.

post.description: Import a benchmark archive produced by benchmark export.
Accept a .tar.gz upload and import it as a benchmark run.

get.description: List all experiment runs with metadata.
All experiment definitions across discovered libraries.
Return experiment metadata and file tree.

delete.description: Delete an experiment's results and clear the trace cache.

get.description:
Read a file from an experiment's output directory.

Pass the relative path as a query parameter, e.g.
``?path=metrics/answer_relevancy.csv``

post.description: Start an in-process experiment worker that streams live to demo-ui.

get.description: List available experiment definitions with metadata.

post.description: Create a new experiment definition in the library's experiments/ directory.

get.description: Return the content of a specific experiment definition.

put.description: Update an existing experiment definition. Supports rename via req.name.

post.description: Run an analysis pipeline. Returns a job_id for polling.
Validate a pipeline manifest against the schema and check DAG integrity.

get.description: Return the content of a specific pipeline definition.

put.description: Update an existing pipeline definition. Supports rename via req.name.

post.description: Run LLM-as-judge evaluation on an events file. Returns a job_id for polling.
Save a MAS manifest + agent files under apps/<mas_name>/.

get.description: List all MAS resources with their manifests and agents.

put.description: Update a MAS resource. Overwrites mas.yaml and agents/ only, preserving other app contents.

get.description: Return a single MAS resource (manifest + agents).

delete.description: Delete a MAS app folder (manifest + agents).

get.description: Capabilities the UI uses to bootstrap a connection.

List manifest schemas resolved from installed packages (runtime, bench, core).

mas-lab-ui should fetch schemas here instead of bundling copies.

Return a manifest schema by registry id.

Query params:
  - ``format=json`` — JSON body (required for ``resolved=1``).
  - ``resolved=1`` — JSON Schema with local ``./`` refs inlined (for UI Ajv).
    Uses the same loader as ``mas.ctl.validate`` — no filesystem access in the browser.

Return the registry of all pipeline step types with config schemas for the React UI.

Query params:
    phase: "pre" | "post" — return only pre-phase or post-phase step types.
           If omitted, returns the post-phase step types.

Return available metrics for the annotate_metrics pipeline step.

Keys are the metric_class values to use in pipeline YAML config.
Values are human-readable display names.
Used by step type: annotate_metrics (config.metric_class).

Return available MCE metrics for eval_batch steps.

Keys are the metric name strings to use in pipeline YAML config.metrics array.
Values are human-readable display names.
Used by step type: eval_batch (config.metrics).
Infra / flavour / workspace YAML for the control panel (basename keys only).

Design-pattern plugins for the agent / overlay canvas builders.

Reshapes ``LabRegistry.list("design_pattern")`` into a UI-friendly catalog:
each entry carries a manifest ``type``, a display ``label``, the source
``library`` (so the UI can group OSS vs experimental patterns) and the
``config_keys`` a pattern may accept.
